name: Obdurate Stiffspine
description: Salute with the point lifted to the brow, then lower it to a levelled guard that frames the foe.

name: Pitiless Impale
description: Open the exchange with a measured thrust whose recovery is already the first half of the second.

name: Gust Trianglespine
description: Pace out the court's width with two even steps to learn where the foe's point can reach.

name: Torrent Thrustspine
description: Beat the foe's blade away with the forte, then beat again from the other side to clear the line.

name: Slenderdurance
description: Cross blades at the middle and hold the bind with both hands while the free foot steps round.

name: Vigilant Rigidtang
description: Touch the foe's blade twice with the point to read its weight and the strength of their grip.

name: Pierceruin
description: Strike the same breastplate twice at once, one point following the other along a shared line.

name: Glint Hardtip
description: Receive the foe's thrust on the blade and return its force along the opposite track at its sender.

name: Tautruin
description: Place two points into the same hole in the armor, the second carrying qi through to the flesh beneath.

name: Tautdurance
description: Stand high on the toes with the blade raised, as a bird poises on a cloud before it falls.

name: Gouge Ruin
description: Dive the point from above the brow down along the foe's centre in one steep line.

name: Gust Pierce
description: Rise light on the toes and drift one step out of the foe's reach with the blade held high.

name: Unassailable Squaretip
description: Beat the foe's thrust down and aside with the flat, like a pinion knocking a rival from the air.

name: Slenderinsight
description: Sweep the senses across the whole field from a high stance and note every foe that moves.

name: Thorn Stiffblade
description: Pin the foe's blade to the ground under the crossguard as a hawk pins prey with its foot.

name: Bracespine Havoc
description: Pitch the whole body forward from the high stance so the point arrives faster than the foe expected.

name: Pitiless Squarepoint
description: Fall onto the foe with the blade leading, qi gathered at the point and weight added from above.

name: Hellish Skewer
description: Loose a ring of quick dropping thrusts that falls on every foe standing in the hawk's shadow.

name: Meteoric Nova Longtang
description: Vanish from the high stance in a streak of qi and arrive with the point already in the foe's gap.

name: Hoarfrost Bracespine
description: Hold the point on the plate track while the free hand covers the track beneath it.

name: Vengeful Stiffspine
description: Thrust along the line of the armor where plate meets plate and the join is weakest.

name: Unseen Longtang
description: Step onto the second track beside the first so the foe's guard faces the wrong way.

name: Murktaut
description: Cross from one track to the other as you parry, so the foe's blade slides off on the far side.

name: Might Trianglespine
description: Move the weight from foot to foot in time with the two tracks to keep both arms free.

name: Verity Rigidtang
description: Read which of the foe's two tracks carries their attention and which they have left unwatched.

name: Gyve Bore
description: Bind the foe's blade on the outer track and press it wide while the point waits on the inner.

name: Corroding Squarepoint
description: Slip the point along the inner track past a guard held too wide and into the ribs.

name: Brutalizing Stiffblade
description: Wedge the point into a seam on one track and drive it deeper with the pommel hand on the other.

name: Shade Skewer
description: Close both tracks around the foe with a steady press of thrusts that leaves no side open.

name: Grave Squaretip
description: Run one thrust on the plate track as a lure and one on the flesh track to pass the armor entirely.

name: Hoarfrost Stiffblade
description: Settle low as if in a deep basin with the point rising from its centre toward the foe.

name: Rampaging Bore
description: Sink the weight into the back leg and rise through the thrust as water rises from a spring.

name: Gustbore
description: Step down and in toward the foe's low line, with the point leading from beneath the knee.

name: Chimeslender
description: Present the blade at a steep slant so the foe's strike slides down its length and off.

name: Elevating Thrustspine
description: Breathe so quietly that the qi gathers like still water and the blade stays unshaken.

name: Beneficent Hardtip
description: Lower a fine thread of qi along the blade and sound the depth of the foe's guard.

name: Gyve Drill
description: Whirl the crossed blades in a slow circle until the foe's grip loosens at the centre.

name: Headlong Pierce
description: Slip low under the foe's thrust like an undercurrent and rise again on their far side.

name: Murkgouge
description: Let the point sink as if tiring, then spring it upward when the foe's guard relaxes.

name: Titanic Thrustspine
description: Sink the whole body behind the point and drive through the target to the hilt.

name: Boremettle
description: Pin the foe in place with the point at their chest as if held at the bottom of a pool.

name: Verity Longtang
description: Settle the qi to dead stillness so that a striking force loses itself on touching the blade.

name: Trianglespine Obduracy
description: Stand with the point forward and the body angled so that two lines of attack meet at the blade.

name: Skewerhavoc
description: Thrust where the foe's two arms meet at the chest and the guard is thinnest.

name: Blinding Gouge
description: Cross to the foe's far side in two firm steps, testing the footing as at a river ford.

name: Torrent Bracespine
description: Slap the foe's blade against the guard like water against a bank and slip past.

name: Intent Squarepoint
description: Let the breath settle like silt in a slow river until the qi runs clear along the arm.

name: Fastening Drill
description: Join the foe's blade from a side angle and carry it into the main line of your own.

name: Iron Impale
description: Throw a thrust so fast and broken in line that the foe cannot follow its course.

name: Unconquered Squaretip
description: Spin the blade in a tight circle to draw the foe's strike in and fling it aside.

name: Veritytaut
description: Trace the foe's movement back to its source in the hips, where every thrust begins.

name: Grievous Rigidtang
description: Fan the point outward in rapid thrusts like a delta's channels, reaching each foe in a wide arc.

name: Hellish Gouge
description: Gather every earlier motion into one surge of weight and qi that bursts through the target.

name: Thornslender
description: Hold the blade across the body to check a charge as a sluice checks a flood.

name: Grievous Psyche Hardtip
description: Send five thrusts down five lines that meet at one point inside the armor and pass through it.

name: Hoarfrost Trianglespine
description: Hold the point and the free hand apart like two hawks poised over the same field.

name: Decimating Impale
description: Send one thrust high to draw the guard and a second low to take the opening it leaves.

name: Meteoric Pierce
description: Stalk forward in a low, patient stride with the point trained on the foe like a hunter's gaze.

name: Equipoise Stiffblade
description: Rake the foe's blade away with the crossguard as a talon rakes at a lure.

name: Veritystrait
description: Watch the foe with one eye on their blade and the other on their feet to learn their plan.

name: Maiming Skewer
description: Hold the foe's blade with the crossguard while the free hand presses down on the flat.

name: Booming Bracespine
description: Stoop beneath a cut and rise in the same breath with the point driving upward into the throat.

name: Intent Gouge
description: Bind the foe's blade and thrust over it in one flowing sequence, each hawk's work finishing the other's.

name: Grievous Stiffspine
description: Hook the crossguard behind the foe's weapon arm and thrust into the exposed flank.

name: Berserk Drill Devastation
description: Strike and bind in the same instant so the point holds the foe fast as it enters.

name: Tautspine
description: Stand narrow and tall as a spire with the point rising from a straight and rigid arm.

name: Hollowtaut
description: Thrust upward along a single steep line from the hip to the foe's collar.

name: Mighttaut
description: Rise forward in short climbing steps that gain height over the foe with each pace.

name: Straitinsight
description: Look down the blade as from a tower and judge the foe's whole stance in one glance.

name: Thornstrait
description: Hold two rising lines of pressure against the foe's blade until it can climb no higher.

name: Tautmettle
description: Beat the foe's blade from its crest and let it fall to the side as the point rises.

name: Rumble Longtang
description: Drive a column of qi up the blade and through the foe's guard in a single hard rise.

name: Facetstrait
description: Meet the foe's strike on one spire of qi and send it up the second back at its sender.

name: Glint Stiffspine
description: Raise two spires of qi along the blade and climb them in a single thrust that no armor stops.

name: Squarepoint Valor
description: Face into the wind with the point steady and the free arm back, bearing the foe's rush.

name: Devastating Thrustspine
description: Thrust along the line the wind draws across the plateau, straight and unbending.

name: Gust Squaretip
description: Skim over the ground in a low, flat step as a gust skims over grass.

name: Adamantine Hardtip
description: Tap the foe's blade away with a light, breeze-quick beat that costs almost nothing.

name: Remnant Rigidtang
description: Taste the shift of the wind to know which way the foe will step before they move.

name: Thornpierce
description: Hold the foe's blade as a gale holds a sail, with steady and relentless pressure.

name: Rumbletaut
description: Sprint three paces under the oath and land the thrust at the end of the run.

name: Hollowgouge
description: Advance like a storm front with qi massed behind the blade and break through the guard.

name: Rumble Bore
description: Strike the foe's blade across its line like a shear of wind and throw their balance off.

name: Unseen Drill Slipstream
description: Pass the foe like a gust, leaving the point behind in the gap that opens as they turn.

name: Invincible Longtang
description: Stand with the heels at the brink and the point forward so the foe must step toward the edge.

name: Nova Pierce
description: Thrust at the foe's lead shoulder to turn them toward the drop at their back.

name: Phantom Bracespine
description: Place each foot with care on narrow ground and step so the foe is the one who nears the edge.

name: Torrent Trianglespine
description: Catch the foe's strike on the ledge of the crossguard and drop it away over the side.

name: Straitrespite
description: Breathe slowly in the dry high air so that qi stays crisp and the grip never slackens.

name: Slenderrespite
description: Feel how close the footing is to its edge, both beneath your own feet and beneath the foe's.

name: Thorn Bore
description: Bind the foe's blade and press them back one step at a time toward the plateau's edge.

name: Webbing Impale
description: Lean toward the edge as if to fall, then thrust when the foe lunges to catch the opening.

name: Ironbore
description: Plant the point in the foe's breastplate and push through with a surge that carries them backward.

name: Granite Pierce
description: Sweep a line of thrusts along the edge so the foe has no safe step in either direction.

name: Blistering Skewer
description: Thrust with the whole drop at your back as the oath, passing armor as if it were not there.

name: Indomitable Stiffblade
description: Set the blade on a fixed bearing and keep it there however the foe circles.

name: Pitiless Squaretip
description: Thrust along the held bearing at a plate's centre, trusting the line more than the eye.

name: Rigidtang Rocketry
description: Pace forward and back along the bearing, never straying from the line the point has set.

name: Unbowed Thrustspine
description: Turn the square blade so a flat face meets the foe's strike and returns to the bearing.

name: Vital Hardtip
description: Hold one long breath along the bearing until qi and line are one.

name: Remnant Longtang
description: Check the bearing against the foe's centre and note any drift before it costs the thrust.

name: Hogtying Squarepoint
description: Bind the foe's blade and keep your own point on its bearing while they strain.

name: Glint Gouge
description: Wedge the point into a plate joint along the bearing and push until the metal parts.

name: Dazzling Impale
description: Turn the body slowly around the point so the bearing never leaves the foe's centre.

name: Tempered Stiffspine
description: Thrust on the bearing with qi spread through the blade until it passes through plate whole.

name: Hour Drill
description: Send wave after wave of thrusts down the same bearing until the foe's guard on it breaks.

name: Invincible Bracespine
description: Hold the bearing so utterly still that a blow against it spends itself without moving the blade.

name: Facet Stiffspine
description: Stand with the oath spoken and the point levelled, bearing the foe's rush as the plateau bears the gale.

name: Nova Impale
description: Loose the thrust on the last word of the oath so voice and point land together.

name: Vanishing Pierce
description: Move at the gale's own pace, steady and unhurried, then burst forward on a single gust.

name: Chime Thrustspine
description: Weigh the foe's resolve through the steel and judge whether it will hold or break.

name: Hoarfrost Drill
description: Bind the foe's blade with a pressure that rises and falls like gusts and wears down their grip.

name: Impalewrath
description: Wait for the foe's guard to drop like fallen fruit and thrust the instant it does.

name: Blistering Bore
description: Charge on a gust of qi with the oath on the lips and the point leading through the guard.

name: Hardtip Spine
description: Stand on the oath and turn the foe's blow back along its own line with the force it carried.

name: Grievous Bore
description: Swear the last oath into the blade and thrust with the full gale of qi behind a single point.

name: Thorntaut
description: Stand in open ground with no cover and the point forward, trusting the blade alone.

name: Slenderwrath
description: Thrust across the open with a long, flat reach that holds the whole width of the field.

name: Gustdrill
description: Take long strides under the wide sky and keep the point steady while the legs run.

name: Murk Squarepoint
description: Sweep the off hand across the blade to push aside a strike with the flat of a gloved palm.

name: Galvanizing Squaretip
description: Fix the eyes on the far horizon and breathe until the qi feels as wide as the sky.

name: Trianglespine Vitality
description: Cast the senses over the whole open field to mark every foe and every gap between them.

name: Gyvestrait
description: Bind the foe's blade in the open with nothing behind you but the oath and the grip.

name: Dazzling Rigidtang
description: Slip across the foe's front on a gust of qi and leave their thrust to cut the empty air.

name: Suffocating Stiffblade
description: Pretend to retreat into the empty ground behind, then thrust the moment the foe pursues.

name: Punishing Trianglespine
description: Charge across open ground with the blade leading, breaking through a guard that has no support beside it.

name: Hellish Pierce
description: Whirl the point through a ring of thrusts that reaches each foe closing from the open ground.

name: Bracespine Devastation
description: Press a broad curtain of thrusts across the foe's front so no side offers escape.

name: Skewer Flash
description: Cross the open ground in one breath so that nothing lies between the point and the foe.

name: Hoarfrost Longtang
description: Hold the arm extended with the point at the foe's eyes so the long reach is shown at once.

name: Devastating Stiffblade
description: Reach the thrust out on a long gust until the point lands at its farthest extent.

name: Silt Rigidtang
description: Hold the exact distance of the blade's reach by stepping with the foe as they move.

name: Unrelenting Thrustspine
description: Flick the extreme tip against the foe's point to turn it aside from a full arm's distance.

name: Tautrespite
description: Sense along the blade where the foe's range ends and where yours holds above it.

name: Thornskewer
description: Bind the foe's blade at its tip so they cannot close while your own hands remain far from theirs.

name: Wrathful Skewer
description: Thrust as the foe rushes in and withdraw on the gust to be gone before their reply.

name: Ferocious Gouge
description: Extend the stab on a surge of qi so that it strikes a hand's breadth beyond the tip.

name: Intent Bore
description: Keep the foe at the blade's long reach with unceasing thrusts that give them no step forward.

name: Chime Hardtip
description: Loose a thread of qi from the point that strikes far past the blade's length.

name: Thorn Stiffspine
description: Stand with the oath spoken aloud and the point on the foe, bearing their rush without moving.

name: Drill Wrath
description: Thrust on the sworn bearing with the full body behind it and no change of line.

name: Gougevortex
description: Walk forward at the pace of the oath, one measured step for each word spoken.

name: Obdurate Longtang
description: Turn the blade a small angle to push away the strike and then restore the bearing.

name: Vitaltaut
description: Let a long calm breath carry the oath down into the arm until the grip is utterly still.

name: Clairvoyant Squaretip
description: Sense whether the foe's own stance holds to any line or shifts with every breath.

name: Gyve Squarepoint
description: Cross blades and hold them in a bind that the foe may not break without first yielding ground.

name: Glinttaut
description: Thrust on a rising wind as the oath is finished and drive through the guard before it re-forms.

name: Facet Gouge
description: Lunge down the bearing with qi massed in the arm, a stroke as unswerving as a sworn word.

name: Impervious Trianglespine
description: Hold the blade on its bearing so firmly that strikes break against it like surf on a rock.

name: Straitruin
description: Drive the point along the sworn bearing with the whole weight of the oath and pass through anything in the line.
